import charms.reactive as reactive
from charmhelpers.core import hookenv
from charms.layer.jenkins import (
    api,
    configuration,
    credentials,
    packages,
    plugins,
    service,
    users,
)


class Orchestrator:
    """Encapsulates orchestration of charm lifecycle stages."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.api = api.Api()
        self.configuration = configuration.Configuration()
        self.credentials = credentials.Credentials()
        self.packages = packages.Packages()
        self.plugins = plugins.Plugins()
        self.service = service.Service()
        self.users = users.Users()

    def wait_for_jenkins(self):
        """Wait for the Jenkins service to be ready."""
        self.service.check_ready()
        self.api.wait()

    def restart_jenkins_and_wait(self):
        """Restart the Jenkins service and wait for it to be ready."""
        hookenv.log("Restarting Jenkins")
        self.api.restart()
        self.wait_for_jenkins()
